entries.title: Review purchase order history
entries.description: Open the new Audit tab on an order to see its changes and activity.

entries.title: Share price-free supplier PDFs
entries.description: Purchase order PDFs for suppliers no longer display pricing.

entries.title: Approve orders before sending
entries.description: Purchase orders now require administrator approval before they can be sent, with approved orders protected from further editing unless returned to draft.

entries.title: Navigate jobs more naturally
entries.description: Job navigation now follows the order Planning, List, Activity, and Calendar.

entries.title: Reach job resources sooner
entries.description: Job resources now appear above feedback on job details.

entries.title: Scan job details more easily
entries.description: Job detail cards start collapsed while keeping useful counts and statuses visible. Tap the full heading area to expand a card.
